notes.title: Minor Update: Laggy Videos
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Faster revives.
[*] Added option to disable high-quality videos.
[/list]

Playing the FlapeeBird game can be a love-hate relationship. To make the game somewhat more tolerable we have increased the speed of the revives.

A few players have been experiencing lag while playing the in-game videos. If you facing this issue we just added an option to disable the high-quality videos so it might play better on more machines. To do this go to the HELP menu on the top right of the main menu and disable it there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751092/3e45e9181cc35fcbfba644942050ee0b9068c091.png[/img]
